scope: Public catalog only; excluded or unpublished products/restaurants are not restored.
method: Bounded full GET (25s,8MB) of each unique image; Chromium Image.decode verifies complete downloaded bytes. HTTP200 HTML is a broken image. Same-ID image variants were checked across all food locales (none differ). Existing source associations are preserved; only five explicit food mappings were editorially reviewed.
